items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He was just wonderful - I'm trying to think - Cuban Bennett. He was really sensational.

ctx.x: John Williams. There was Louis Armstrong, Bennie Carter, Johnny Hodges, Fats Waller, Willie the Lion, and Bennie Carter's cousin that played trumpet. He was just wonderful - I'm trying to think - Cuban Bennett. He was really sensational. He played somewhat like Sweets but all these modern changes and everything. He was just beautiful. Louis Armstrong I mentioned, and J. P. Johnson, and they had this great jam session going. I was hiding practically. My husband says, 'Get up and play.' I said, Oh no,' and I…
